title: Binance Launches 8YA: Road to Abu Dhabi Giveaway in Collaboration With BWT Alpine F1
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to unveil the  Binance 8YA: Road to Abu Dhabi Giveaway  — our turbo-charged collab with the  BWT Alpine F1® Team  in honor of Binance’s eighth anniversary.  New users who join the exchange with referral code  “ALPINE8”  can shift into top gear for a chance to win a VIP season-finale race experience in Abu Dhabi, exclusive Alpine collectibles signed, and passes to  Binance Blockchain Week 2025  in Dubai! Promotion Period: 2025-07-14 13:00 (UTC) to 2025-07-31 23:59 (UTC) Binance’s 8YA: Road to Abu Dhabi Giveaway Binance’s  8YA: Road to Abu Dhabi  Giveaway campaign includes the distribution of two (2) grand prizes during the Promotional Period. Each grand prize contains the following rewards:  Abu Dhabi Race Week Experience for Two (flights / accommodation not included); Alpine Collectibles: Signed Mini-Helmet Signed BWT Alpine F1 Team Cap Two (2) Binance Blockchain Week Dubai 2025 Tickets Note : Rewards are non-transferable and subject to eligibility criteria as outlined below. How to Participate: Eligibility: New Binance users who  register   during the Promotion Period   with referral code “ ALPINE8”  and complete KYC. Residents of sanctioned or trade-restricted regions, plus Binance employees, partners, or their immediate families, are ineligible. Eligible new Binance users who fulfill the following steps will be able to participate in the giveaway: Click on the survey link which will be sent via the email tied to their Binance account. Complete the survey during the Promotion Period.  Duplicates or late submissions will be void. Reward Distribution A Binance-appointed panel scores eligible entries on accuracy, clarity, creativity, and originality; Binance’s decisions are final.  The  top two scorers  will each receive  one Grand Prize , with the rewards listed above.  Winner Notification & Claiming: Winners will be emailed by  2025-08-06 23:59 (UTC)  and must confirm acceptance within  48 hours  or the prize will be forfeited. Prize Fulfilment: Travel arrangements and all related costs (flights, hotels, visas, insurance, taxes) are the sole responsibility of each winner. Physical collectibles will be shipped after winners complete required documentation. For more information on reward terms and selection processes, please refer to the official  campaign T&Cs.
